text: Hukumar wasan motsa jiki ta duniya WA ta cire sunan Shehu Gusau daga shafinta .

entities.text: Hukumar wasan motsa jiki ta duniya WA
entities.label: ORG

trans_text: Hukumar wasan motsa jiki ta duniya WA has removed Shehu Gusau's name from its website.

text: Hukumar ta duniya ta dauki wannan matakin ne kwanaki kadan bayan kammala mabanbantan zabukan shugabancin hukumar AFN da ya rabu gida biyu kuma aka gudanar a ranar 14 ga watan Yuni inda Shehu Gusau da Tonobok Okowa kowanensu ke ikirarin zama zababben shugaban hukumar .
trans_text: The world body took this step just days after the conclusion of the controversial AFN presidential elections, which split the house in two and were held on ranar 14 ga watan Yuni, where Shehu Gusau and Tonobok Okowa each claim to be the elected president of the body.

text: Haka zalika WA ta kuma goge sunan babban daraktan hukumar AFN Siminialayi Pepple daga shafin nata .
trans_text: Similarly, WA also deleted the name of the Director General of the AFN Siminialayi Pepple from its website.

text: AFN ta kasance cikin rikici tun daga shekarar 2019 bayan da kwamitin gudanarwa da Gusau ke jagoranta ya bukaci ma'aikatar wasanni ta kasa ta baiwa hukumar damar cin gashin kai .
trans_text: AFN has been in conflict since 2019 after the executive committee led by Gusau requested the Ministry of Sports to grant the association autonomy.

text: Hakan ne dai ya haifar da dakatar da Gusau tare da magoya bayansa daga shugabancin hukumar .
trans_text: That is what led to the suspension of Gusau and his supporters from the leadership of the commission.

text: Tokyo 2020 : An baiwa ‘yan kallo dubu 10 damar shiga kowane wasa .
trans_text: Tokyo 2020: 10,000 spectators were allowed to attend each match.

text: Hakan na zuwa ne ta cikin wata sanarwa da masu shirya gasar suka fitar don bayyana matsayar kasar ta Japan kan karbar bakuncin gasar yayin da Coronavirus ke kara kamari a wasu kasashen duniya .
trans_text: This came through a statement issued by the organizers of the games to clarify the position of Japan on hosting the games as the Coronavirus continues to spread in some countries of the world.

text: Sanarwar ta kuma ce biyo bayan bukatar masana kiwon lafiya , gudanar da wasannin gasar ba tare da da ‘yan kallo ba shine zabi mafi karancin hadari wajen yada cutar COVID - 19 .
trans_text: The statement also said that following the recommendation of health experts, conducting the competition matches without spectators is the least risky option for spreading the COVID-19 virus.

text: An dai cimma matsayar baiwa ‘yan kallo dubu 10 a kasar damar shiga kallon wasan yayin wani zama da kwararru a fanin lafiya na kasar suka yi da masu shirya gasar don dakile barazanar yaduwar cutar Corona .
trans_text: The target of allowing 10,000 spectators to enter the country to watch the match has been achieved during a meeting between the country's health experts and the organizers to curb the threat of the spread of the Corona virus.

text: Za kuma a fara gasar ne a ranar 23 ga watan Yuli mai kamawa a birnin Tokyo .
trans_text: The competition will also begin on ranar 23 ga watan Yuli and end in birnin Tokyo.

text: Messi ya yi kunne doki da Mascherano a yawan wasanni ga Argentina .
trans_text: Messi played more matches for Argentina than Mascherano.

text: Shi dai Javier Mascherano ya bugawa kasar ta Argentina wasanni 147 a tarihin da Messi ya karya a fafatawa da kasar ta yi da Paraguay a gasar Copa America ta 2021 .
trans_text: Javier Mascherano played 147 matches for Argentina, a record that Messi broke in the match against Paraguay in the 2021 Copa America tournament.
